acceptance_gate.existing_tool_or_non_software_choice: discovery.test.js existing-tool case: software is not_recommended because an existing tool covers the need; existing_tool is a candidate; human_led and hybrid exclusions carry reasons
acceptance_gate.software_suitable_case: discovery.test.js software case: software proposal is a candidate after one revision answering a contested-urgency finding, with data and tool-gap evidence usable
acceptance_gate.insufficient_evidence: discovery.test.js insufficient case: problem evidence is only an inaccessible source; the run makes one model call and proposes nothing
acceptance_gate.proposal_independence: discovery.test.js software case: every first proposal's provider input has 4 messages (system, packet, assignment, locator) and contains no other proposal's output or skeptic input; result.independence.verified with identical packet hash and shared inputs = [locator]; discovery-domain.test.js: a context that lists a sibling is reported
